conditions.leftValue: ={{ !($('Pausa da conversa').all().some((i) => { const a = String((i.json || {}).ate || ''); if (!a) return false; const t = new Date(/[zZ]$|[+-]\d\d:?\d\d$/.test(a) ? a : a.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z').getTime(); return t > Date.now(); })) }}
